ranked.headline: Single-cell methods link chromatin accessibility, expression and spatial context
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and publications extend multi-omic single-cell models to predict expression, transfer regulatory structure, and audit benchmarks.

ranked.headline: Multimodal fusion and mechanistic probing extend protein and genomic prediction
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and publications pair predictive accuracy with interpretability and mechanistic probing of learned protein and genomic representations.

ranked.headline: Statistical frameworks assign trait genetic risk to specific genes and cell populations
ranked.summary: Single-cell atlases and Bayesian fine mapping now tie trait associations to specific genes and cell types in human tissues.

ranked.headline: Web and open-source tools for peptide matching, visualization, and ortholog prediction
ranked.summary: New releases and open-source tools make peptide, ortholog, and growth-temperature resources directly usable beyond their originating studies.

ranked.headline: Quantifying feedback and network organization as measurable cellular state properties
ranked.summary: Causal intervention, integrated omics, and Raman spectroscopy are being used to read out feedback and network organization as cell-state properties.

ranked.headline: Coupling histology, spatial omics and clinical data in learned tumor representations
ranked.summary: Multimodal models now link H&E, spatial proteomics, transcriptomics and single-cell data to clinical endpoints, with new open and benchmarking resources.

ranked.headline: Spatial transcriptomics registered to tissue imaging maps organ and brain architecture
ranked.summary: Coupling spatial transcriptomics with matched imaging now resolves organ-scale, volumetric, and developmental tissue organization.

ranked.headline: Single-cell models tested for batch invariance, optimal layers, and perturbation transfer
ranked.summary: Single-cell foundation and generative models are now evaluated on nuisance robustness and on which layers carry task-relevant information.

ranked.headline: Foundation model embeddings tested for variant, biomarker, and multi-omics prediction
ranked.summary: Genomic, pathology, and single-cell foundation models are now assessed through interpretability probes, ensemble integration, and cross-modal generation.

ranked.headline: Single-cell methods link perturbations, tRNA dynamics and transcriptome heterogeneity
ranked.summary: Current single-cell work pairs new algorithms and assays with explicit quantitative assessment, from genotyping accuracy to perturbation divergence scoring and…

ranked.headline: Evaluation design decides which machine learning performance claims in biology hold
ranked.summary: Leakage-free and multi-model benchmarks now test whether reported gains in protein, TB, and omics ML survive rigorous comparison.

ranked.headline: Inferring hidden biological parameters from sparse quantitative measurements
ranked.summary: Simulation-trained and theory-based estimators now pair with sparse experimental readouts in antibody, mRNA delivery, and blinatumomab dosing studies.

ranked.headline: Benchmarks expose accuracy limits in transcript, RNA modification and metagenomic tools
ranked.summary: Recent benchmarks show that single metrics such as AUROC and unflagged ambiguity can mask tool limitations across RNA and metagenomic analyses.

ranked.headline: Generative models steered by explicit constraints for de novo molecular design
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and papers pair diffusion and LLM generators with RL, shape, and pocket constraints to steer de novo molecular design.

ranked.headline: Genetic and 3D genome context shape regulatory variation across human tissues
ranked.summary: Recent studies place regulatory activity within genetic variation, DNA methylation, chromatin conformation and cell-type context across tissues and development.

ranked.headline: Computational models link disorder and structure to protein interaction networks
ranked.summary: Proteome-wide predictions of phase separation and disordered interactions are now resolved at residue and network scales.

ranked.headline: Physics-informed neural models predict molecular properties and interaction energies
ranked.summary: Recent work pairs quantum-informed neural models with explicit benchmarking, making cross-study evaluation standards increasingly pressing.

ranked.headline: Structural graphs and dynamics are being used to condition antibody and binder prediction
ranked.summary: Recent preprints pair structural graphs, dynamics, and ensembles with sequence models for antibody interface, developability, and design tasks.

ranked.headline: Biomolecular energetic models transferred to new polymer and peptide chemistries
ranked.summary: Energetic and learned models are being carried into polypeptoids, cyclic peptides, and amyloid-prone disordered proteins.

ranked.headline: Structure-based ligand prioritization shifts to pocket queries and proteome-wide docking
ranked.summary: Structure-derived queries, pose datasets, and proteome-scale docking are now each paired with explicit benchmarking or experimental validation.

ranked.headline: Similarity-driven methods advance biomolecular sequence and trajectory analysis
ranked.summary: New tools avoid quadratic pairwise bottlenecks in protein alignment, sequence grouping, and hierarchical analysis of large biomolecular datasets.

ranked.headline: Weak-selection fixation, gene-sharing network generation, and lineage phase transitions
ranked.summary: Mechanistic and statistical-physics models now address selection, gene sharing and lineage structure in microbial populations.

ranked.headline: Interactive tools extract hierarchy, trendlines and microbial synergies from omics data
ranked.summary: Recent preprints package multi-layer omics analyses into interactive tools for gene hierarchy, sample trendlines and microbiome feature pairs.

ranked.headline: Sequence models generate disordered proteins and classify RNA and DNA sequences
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and a published RNA model test what sequence-trained models learn for biological design and regulatory inference.

ranked.headline: FD-MD simulations link condensate interfaces to amyloid nucleation and fibril morphology
ranked.summary: Condensate interfaces are now modeled as nucleation sites where β-motif rigidity and molecular flux shape fibril growth morphology.

ranked.headline: LLM agents grounded in tool docs, literature graphs, and containers for bioinformatics
ranked.summary: Five April 2026 preprints describe agentic LLM systems that ground generation in documentation, skill graphs, containers, or declarative pipelines.

ranked.headline: Graph databases model population genomic variant storage and summary statistics
ranked.summary: Mid-April 2026 preprints propose graph databases for population genomic data and pair them with faster VCF filtering and variant annotation.

ranked.headline: Conformation and protonation states gate catalysis and selectivity in enzymes and motors
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and a publication apply MD, QM/MM, and AI-based cofolding to link conformational and protonation states to enzyme and motor function.

ranked.headline: Simulations resolve transient channel states, blocker sites, and calmodulin dynamics
ranked.summary: Adaptive sampling and MD-guided design now probe conductive TMEM16A and redesigned calmodulin states.

ranked.headline: Processing and inference choices determine completeness of imaged structural data
ranked.summary: Recent work tests whether cryo-ET processing, MSA pairing, and stoichiometry-agnostic model scoring recover complete structural information.

ranked.headline: Dynamical models of how cells maintain organized compartments and states over time
ranked.summary: Recent preprints apply kinetic and stochastic formalisms to organelle, signaling, membrane and lineage-level cellular dynamics.

ranked.headline: Conductance models link chloride and Ca2+ handling to firing and seizure transitions
ranked.summary: Recent models tie chloride homeostasis, Ca2+ and BK channels, and neuromodulation to neuronal excitability, seizure stages, and robust firing.

ranked.headline: New methods infer microbial networks and single-cell mutual information from count data
ranked.summary: Reusable packages now bring sparse compositional regression, network estimation and fast mutual information testing to QIIME 2, R and scRNA-seq workflows.

ranked.headline: Inferring division rates and continuous dynamics from single-cell time-series data
ranked.summary: Time-series single-cell data increasingly support direct estimation of stochastic and continuous-time dynamical parameters from explicit models.

ranked.headline: Open-source tools automate detection and measurement in fluorescence and plankton images
ranked.summary: Full-resolution imaging data are now being converted to quantitative readouts by open-source, end-to-end detection-and-measurement workflows.

ranked.headline: Sequence-based models predict TF binding and chromatin accessibility across species
ranked.summary: Cross-species transfer of regulatory predictions is now tested on ChIP-seq and accessibility data from human and mouse.

ranked.headline: Sequencing artifacts and benchmarking reshape somatic variant calling accuracy
ranked.summary: Recent benchmarks and artifact analyses expose platform- and library-specific errors that confound low-VAF somatic calls in clinical pipelines.

ranked.headline: Long reads and complete assemblies resolve sequence that reference-anchored pipelines miss
ranked.summary: Long-read assembly, complete reference construction, and imputed variant panels now expose variation that reference-anchored pipelines leave uncharacterized.
